text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello, Sis? Sorry for calling out of 
the blue."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... You know, the thing is... I...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I finally figured it out...

It has been two days since Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi collapsed. Her training is 
scheduled to resume tomorrow.

Plenty of Umamusume have fallen ill in the 
summer and still made it in time for 
autumn. Besides, summer isn't even over 
yet.

...I refuse to give up at this point. I 
jot down training methods, one after 
another. As long as she desires it, I'll 
provide her with the best path forward—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, before that, there's something I 
wanted to ask!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, please tell me what your 
childhood dream was!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's a common story! Like wanting to 
become an idol, or wanting to be a hero.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Like wanting to become a flower. That kind 
of thing you can't actually be!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...How does someone let go of an old dream 
like that?

As she asked, her face looked more mature 
than yesterday when I visited her, and 
more grown-up than the day before when I 
nursed her...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Let's just call it quits!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Admiration is just admiration! I am me! 
Starting today, why don't we talk about 
things that actually suit me?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
There are no “guarantees” for me! Giving 
it my all would just be a waste!

text_block_list.text: —Surely, just like Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was an Umamusume who simply wanted to 
become strong.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I need to know my limits.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—That is why, please teach me. Teach me 
how to graduate.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Enough already!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please don't force yourself to hang out 
with me. I don't want to cause you any 
more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...The ideal I yearned for was simply too 
big for me to grasp. That is all there is 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—That is why, please teach me. Teach me 
how to graduate.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer-san knows the right way to 
train, and everything else too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

"...And Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi lowered her 
head, turning a blind eye to any other 
help."

Seeking only a way to cast aside that 
longing.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

It was because she smiled so powerfully 
like that.

No matter what words were called out to 
her, none of the voices pleading for her 
to stay reached her ears.

All you'll let me do is give you a push 
forward, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

All I said was to wait until the final 
night of the training camp. That we should 
talk once we've both cooled down.
That was all I could bring myself to say.
